title: Special Topics in Genres/Auteurs/Cinema Movements; The Suspense Thriller in World Cinema
description: Through screenings, readings, and discussions, this online course offers students the opportunity to examine major suspense thriller films in world cinema. We will screen films from different countries in a spectrum of sub-genres (such as detective thrillers, psychological thrillers, spy thrillers, police thrillers, science- fiction thrillers) in order to understand current artistic, critical, ideological, and theoretical debates in cinema and media studies.
